name: Meissner wall
description:
Three interlocking name walls in one collection, with recessed front lettering and plain, unnumbered backs. All bricks use 5.0 mm studs (increased after both 4.8 and 4.9 mm studs were loose in physical fit tests); the underside cavity and clutch tubes retain their tested dimensions. The 0.6 mm lettering recess leaves 0.9 mm of front wall.
Meissner: 12 studs wide, 3 bricks high, 2 studs deep. Ten bricks in staggered rows of 4+4+4, 2+4+4+2, 4+4+4 studs. Body 95.8 x 15.8 x 28.8 mm; 30.6 mm including top studs.
Käte: 6 studs wide, 2 bricks high, 2 studs deep. Two 2 x 4 and two 2 x 2 bricks in staggered rows of 4+2 and 2+4 studs. Body 47.8 x 15.8 x 19.2 mm; 21 mm including top studs. Both umlaut dots are included.
Carlo: 8 studs wide, 2 bricks high, 2 studs deep. Five bricks in staggered rows of 4+4 and 2+4+2 studs. Body 63.8 x 15.8 x 19.2 mm; 21 mm including top studs.
Print the corresponding meissner-wall.stl, kate-wall.stl or carlo-wall.stl once for a complete set. Files containing combined are assembly previews only. Individual bricks are prefixed by name to keep each set distinct. Use 100% scale, studs up, open undersides on the bed, supports and internal brims off, and 0.12-0.16 mm layers. The print plate preserves each course in its own row, bottom course at the back (+Y), top at the front (-Y), ordered left to right (+X).
The original underside grip was physically tested successfully. The enlarged 5.0 mm studs and new lettering sets still need a physical fit test.
